description_en: Modifies the parameters of a PolarDB Search cluster
description_zh: 修改 PolarDB Search 集群参数
name: ModifySearchParameters

parameters.help_en: The ID of the PolarDB primary cluster, which is used to locate the Search cluster associated with the current account. Before you call this operation, you must enable the Search feature in the console. You can check the status by using the SearchClusterStatus field returned by DescribeDBClusterAttribute. Usage notes: Prerequisites: The cluster must have the Search feature enabled in the console. You can verify the status by using the SearchClusterStatus field returned by DescribeDBClusterAttribute
parameters.help_zh: PolarDB 主集群 ID，用于定位当前账号关联的 Search 集群。调用前需在控制台启用 Search 功能；可通过 DescribeDBClusterAttribute 返回的 SearchClusterStatus 字段确认状态。调用说明：前提条件说明：集群必须已通过控制台启用 Search 功能，可通过 DescribeDBClusterAttribute 的 SearchClusterStatus 字段确认状态
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: A non-empty JSON object string where the keys are parameter names and all values must be strings, such as 10% for percentages or 48mb for capacities. You can only modify parameters that are visible and modifiable in the template of the current version. Dynamic parameters take effect and are persisted immediately. Static parameters take effect after a restart triggered by the task flow. A success response only indicates that the task is accepted
parameters.help_zh: 非空 JSON 对象字符串，键为参数名，所有值必须为字符串，例如百分比 10%、容量 48mb。仅允许修改当前版本模板中可见且可修改的参数。动态参数持久化生效，静态参数由任务流重启生效；成功仅表示任务已受理
parameters.name: parameters

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. A successful response indicates that the parameter modification task has been accepted, but does not indicate that the parameters have taken effect
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID。成功表示参数修改任务已受理，不表示参数已生效
RequestId.title_en: 请求 ID。成功表示参数修改任务已受理，不表示参数已生效。
RequestId.title_zh: 请求 ID。成功表示参数修改任务已受理，不表示参数已生效。
